name: data-analysis-studio-frontend
description: TypeScript frontend for Data Analysis Studio -- the interactive grid and charts, bundled with esbuild into one offline-runnable file.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=iife --minify --sourcemap --external:./wasm-pkg/* && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp styles.css dist/styles.css && (test -d src/wasm-pkg && cp -r src/wasm-pkg dist/wasm-pkg || echo 'wasm not built yet, skipping (app still works without it)')
scripts.dev: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp styles.css dist/styles.css && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=iife --sourcemap --external:./wasm-pkg/* --watch
